title: boehmeria incana
intro: Boehmeria incana, commonly known as the Roving Pilea or Himalayan nettle, is a type of flowering plant in the family Urticaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, as well as its ability to lower blood pressure and improve digestive health. The therapeutic actions of Boehmeria incana include its antioxidant, anti-diabetic, and anti-cancer properties, making it a valuable natural remedy. The bioactive constituents of Boehmeria incana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
